title: Roblox downloaded 145GB models from us (including adult content) without asking
script:
Roblox downloaded one hundred forty-five gigabytes of 3D models from Open3DLab without permission.
The unauthorized scraping harvested thousands of user creations, including adult content hosted on the third-party sites.
Site administrators spotted the massive data extraction and blocked the offending IP addresses tied to the platform.
Creators discovered their intellectual property being harvested to fuel generative training sets for AI development.
Roblox has not yet issued a public statement explaining how explicit files ended up in their dataset.
Would you trust Roblox with your 3D assets?
